reviews.weakest: 4: The exported memory agent is Python, not “plain instructions,” and the linked sources cannot guarantee that a file made by “any AI” will load or work for a friend.
reviews.fix:
Replace steps 4–6 with:
  • Add an agent.Click the registry icon at the top right, choose one, and click Add. It becomes available on your next message.
  • Use it.Ask Brainstem to use that agent for one real task.
  • Hand it on.Click the agents icon, then Export next to that agent, and send the downloaded file to a friend. They can drag it onto their Brainstem.
